title: National Ignition Facility fusion ignition and the realization gap to energy systems
sourceNativeSummary: After decades of experiments and repeated near-misses, NIF achieved target ignition/energy gain on December 5 2022 with 2.05 MJ laser energy delivered to the target and 3.15 MJ fusion output; later shots repeated ignition with higher yield.
rivalOrBoundary: Ignition validates an important physical regime but does not itself materialize a commercial fusion-energy system, which requires repetition rate, plant efficiency, target manufacture, durability and economics.
